lines.text: if i see your eyes in mine
does it mean i'm going loopy
have you recently sipped pickle brine
and thought it was sweeter than rolled up tootsies
a foul taste used to rile me up like nothing else could
leaving my mood just to combust
but since your little while the world seems so exquisite
like it was made just to dazzle us
you seem to be my umami
a taste that we've all come to love
salty bitter sweet and sour are incomplete
without your last one to snug them like a four-fingered glove
my love
the receptors of my lips used to be in superstition
it was you who first earned their trust
and if i had the choice
you'd settle on my skin as gold dust
never before did an apple taste so clear
or a lemon so plain in its bite
i hear your voice ringing in my ear
like a perfect peach so ripe
you seem to be my umami
a taste that we've all come to love
salty bitter sweet and sour are incomplete
without your last one to snug them like a four-fingered glove
all my tastebuds are sighing with pleasure
at the sensation they never knew before
salty bitter sweet and sour are incomplete
without your last one to give the lonely four a core
and so much more
so much more

n1.body:
the first time i fell in love when i was 18 i remember thinking: no matter what happens in the future, i will never feel quite this way again, so i should make the most of it and get a song out of it if i can. ever the pragmatic. the person in question and i remain friends and i am grateful for their continued presence in my life.
on another note a lyrical inspiration came from a documentary on the german/french tv channel arte about the 'umami' flavour. the concept intrigued me, it is fair to say.

my partner now makes our own pickles and we use the brine to make a delicious bread spread!

n9.body:
around the time of the relationship, which only lasted 2 months, i listened to marvin gaye's 'i heard it through the grapevine' album many many times (my favourite song is 'change what you can') and i can clearly see the its influence on the melody in the chorus, which is a particular joy to sing!
it is also amazing how love can complete things we never thought were lacking
